hook_line: DIET AND WALKS PUT 60.9% IN REMISSION

hook_stat.sub: Estimated remission rate at six months

stats.label: Average weight lost in six months

diaspora_bullets: Diabetes strikes South Asians earlier, at lower weights
Walking 80% of days: 8.24 times the odds
news_summary: A six-month programme of a traditional Indian diet and daily walking put an estimated 60.9% of adults with early Type 2 diabetes into remission.
payoff: Single-arm study: do not change medication without a doctor.
